description: Byte-exact excerpts of the device-less connect decision in openclaw ab5a30ea: the client id and mode constants, roleCanSkipDeviceIdentity, the local backend self-pairing skip, local cli scope preservation and the missing-device decision. readiness-gateway-ab5a-model.test.mjs runs them, with types stripped, against the readiness fixture model (helpers/readiness-gateway.mjs). Each excerpt is lines start..end of path at sha (blob is the file's git blob id there); re-check one with: git -C <openclaw> show <sha>:<path> | sed -n '<start>,<end>p' | sha256sum.
